mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for exterior restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting an exterior restoration contractor, look for experience with similar projects, especially if your property is historic or has unique architectural features. Verify their licensing, insurance, and client references. A reputable contractor will provide a detailed proposal, clearly outlining the scope of work, materials, timeline, and cost. Effective communication and a clear understanding of your vision are also crucial. Prioritize contractors who demonstrate expertise in quality craftsmanship and adherence to safety standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with relevant experience, verify licenses and insurance, check references, and ensure they provide a detailed proposal with clear communication.
